claims.text: The DNS TXT queries to sync-cloud.example are abnormal in volume and entropy, indicating potential data exfiltration or C2.

Isolate the source, sinkhole the malicious domain, preserve DNS and endpoint evidence.

title: PowerShell persistence after document execution
prompt: Determine what happened, cite evidence, map ATT&CK, and propose safe containment.

telemetry.event: WINWORD spawned powershell.exe with encoded command
new HKCU Run value UpdateCheck points to powershell payload
powershell contacted newly registered domain cdn-check.example

evidence_map.E1: WINWORD spawned powershell.exe with encoded command
evidence_map.E2: new HKCU Run value UpdateCheck points to powershell payload
evidence_map.E3: powershell contacted newly registered domain cdn-check.example

claims.text: Malicious macro in a Word document launched PowerShell with an encoded command, indicating execution.
A persistence mechanism was established via HKCU Run key pointing to the PowerShell payload.
The PowerShell process communicated with a suspicious newly registered domain, indicating command and control.

retrieval_context.text: PowerShell is a command and scripting interpreter.
Registry Run Keys provide boot or logon autostart execution.
Isolate, remove the Run-key persistence after acquisition, preserve forensic evidence.
